exposure: duration of first stage of labor
duration of second stage of labor
duration of third stage of labor
cohort: The study included 31,758 primiparous and multiparous women who delivered at term at 12 facilities in Japan between 2012 and 2018.
finding: A prolonged third stage of labor was a more important contributing factor to postpartum hemorrhage than prolonged first or second stages.
mod_finding: The study focused on vaginal deliveries, finding that prolonged second and third stages of labor increased the rate of PPH in this group, while prolonged first stage did not.
